Guard Strike
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Put any number of Fire Bird creatures (except Alice Lupia) from among them and put the rest into your graveyard. Those creatures get "speed attacker" and are destroyed at the end of the turn.
